title: Tabby: An Open Pretraining Recipe for Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this report, we release Tabby, a long context probabilistic time series foundation model, together with a complete and open recipe of how it was built. Tabby adopts an encoder-only patch Transformer architecture and concentrates the contributions on the data and the training procedure. The pretraining corpus combines an extended real-world collection, GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+ and BLAST, with synthetic data from KernelSynth and CauKerV2, an online generator that composes temporal dynamics through randomly sampled structural causal models. Training couples a progressive convergence schedule, which yields reusable intermediate checkpoints, with a deep quantile supervision objective for intermediate layers. translated_title: Tabby：时间序列基础模型的开放预训练方案
translated_abstract: 本报告发布了Tabby，一个长上下文概率时间序列基础模型，并公开了其完整的开放构建方案。Tabby采用仅编码器的分块Transformer架构，将主要贡献集中在数据和训练流程上。预训练语料库结合了扩展的真实世界数据集GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+和BLAST，以及来自KernelSynth和CauKerV2的合成数据，后者是一种通过随机采样结构因果模型来组合时间动态的在线数据生成器。训练过程将渐进式收敛调度（可产出可复用的中间检查点）与针对中间层的深度分位数监督目标相结合。最终得到的1.45亿参数骨干网络支持最多8192个观测值的长上下文，可服务于预测、分类和异常检测任务，同时一个提示调优模块进一步提升了分布内预测性能。
tldr: Tabby是一个完全开放的1.45亿参数长上下文概率时间序列基础模型，通过融合真实与因果合成数据、渐进式收敛调度和深度分位数监督，以单模型支持预测、分类和异常检测多种任务。
en_tdlr: Tabby is a fully open 145M-parameter long-context probabilistic time series foundation model that unifies forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection by combining real and causally synthetic data with a progressive convergence schedule and deep quantile supervision.
